notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Agents Of Black Sun, Xizor, Coruscant, 'that site... does anyone know its name?', Prep Def, Moby Points, IAO, Crush the Feeble Rebellion; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'that site... does anyone know its name?' dested Coruscant: Imperial City because the objective deploys Imperial City (with Xizor there) and the Coruscant system.
Posted 'Crush the Feeble Rebellion' dested Crush The Rebellion (pulls I Have You Now / Evader, opponent limited to two battle destiny at mobile sites, as the strategy describes).

Posted 'DB' dested Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark): the strategy moves Xizor to 'the spaceport DB'. Posted 'DS DB' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay (DeckTech precedent); 'CC DB' dested the Dark Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay).

Posted 'Destiny 6 Emperor' dested Emperor Palpatine (destiny 6); 'Fett w/Blaster' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Twi'lek' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Opp Enf' dested Oppressive Enforcement; 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order; 'U3P0' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
Prince Xizor is posted once in the starting cards and x2 under Characters (3 copies of a unique character), kept as posted.
Section 'Red (the remainder)' holds the Effects and Interrupts. Total 60.
